scope: Read-only public sign-in UI. No authenticated application views or production repository inspected.

ui_operations: Read accessibility tree and DOM-backed styles and dimensions

findings.observed: Desktop sign-in CTA fills almost the entire viewport (1388 CSS px at 1440 px).
findings.reference: MK-02-D has a compact centered action in the bottom action bar.
findings.recommended_investigation: Inspect AuthLayout, Button width variants and desktop breakpoint CSS in the actual repository.

findings.observed: Sign-in title/logo grouping is centered; the reference frame uses different title alignment.
findings.recommended_investigation: Match the actual viewport header alignment and spacing; preserve the approved brand asset.

findings.observed: The terms/privacy sentence is exposed as a button about 25.34 CSS px high at widths 390 and 834.
findings.reference: Design minimum interactive target is 44 CSS px.
findings.recommended_investigation: Verify keyboard semantics and accessible hit area without changing the reference typography.

positive_observations: Observed dark background, surface, text and action colors match the design token family.
The observed public sign-in page had no document horizontal overflow at 320, 390 and 834 CSS px.
unverified: Repository code and CSS root cause
Native mobile keyboard and device behavior
comparison_rules: Use the same theme, data, role, state, viewport and focus state.
Compare the viewport inside the reference frame; exclude PDF presentation chrome and mock device borders.
Dark appearance by itself is not a defect.
Do not generalize the public-page observations to authenticated views.
